(actor wait_dynamic
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n async active_low))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (input cycles (width 4))
    (output flag)
    (output done))
  (drive tick
    (flag 1))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (wait cycles)
    (drive tick)
    (complete done)))

(actor wait_dynamic_sample
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n async active_low))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (input cycles (width 4))
    (input din (width 8))
    (output out (width 8))
    (output done))
  (drive (outp val)
    (out val))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (sample din as hold)
    (wait cycles)
    (drive outp hold)
    (complete done)))

(actor wait_dynamic_sample_assemble

    (output done))
  (drive (captured val)
    (sample_out val))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (sample din as hold)
    (wait cycles)
    (assemble header payload as packet)
    (drive captured hold)
    (complete done)))

    (output out_payload (width 8))

  (drive (captured val)

  (transaction main

    (sample din as hold)
    (wait cycles)
    (extract packet as out_header out_payload out_crc)

    (complete done)))

  (drive (captured val)

(actor wait_dynamic_sample_contract
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n async active_low))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (input ack)
    (input cycles (width 4))
    (input din (width 8))
    (output sample_out (width 8))
    (output done))
  (drive (captured val)
    (sample_out val))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (sample din as hold)
    (wait cycles)
    (assert (monitor (within ack 3)) "ack_seen")
    (drive captured hold)
    (complete done)))

(actor wait_dynamic_sample_sync_all
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n async active_low))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (input cycles (width 4))
    (input din (width 8))
    (output flag)
    (output sample_out (width 8))
    (output done))
  (drive tick
    (flag 1))
  (drive (captured val)
    (sample_out val))
  (transaction worker
    (on start)
    (drive tick)
    (complete done))
  (transaction parent
    (on start)
    (spawn worker as w0)
    (spawn worker as w1)
    (sample din as hold)
    (wait cycles)
    (await_all done)
    (drive captured hold)
    (complete done)))
